title: 導きの標となりしは智

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki becomes convinced that pushing herself is the best way to find her obsession, and she starts dedicating her every waking moment to training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I have a bad feeling about the way things are going, so I suggest we shake things up by taking a day to watch the autumn Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At the race, the fierce battle between Oguri Cap and Tamamo Cross takes center stage.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: During the competition, Yaeno Muteki realizes that Oguri Cap is showing what her "obsession" is—defeating Tamamo Cross.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even the calm and composed Oguri Cap has an obsession. Yaeno Muteki becomes deeply concerned over her apparent lack of one.
